searchText: It was never actually introduced as an EIP. It was just a proposal for an EIP. Didn't even make it to draft. This is an incredibly common thing, usually it means the idea has no champion. For example, I have an idea for an EIP from a couple years ago that I still think is a good idea and has received generally positive feedback, but I he never gotten around to pushing it through so it still sits as an issue with no formal EIP.
